limitations: BingX asksCoin/bidsCoin additional arrays were observed in actual API responses but not enumerated in the short official markdown. Parser requires these explicitly coin-named fields and does not silently fall back to contracts/unspecified units. Full unit certification is still needed before any execution.

Bitget orderbook schema itself describes quantity, not a separate lot-unit field. Base-coin interpretation is for these linear USDT futures only, with baseCoin/quoteCoin/type identity checks, and is not generalized to COIN-FUTURES.
BingX source updateTime was materially older than receive time. No published funding rate is treated as locked or as a realized cash payment.
REST books are not atomic; local clock offset not automatically corrected; all outputs remain HOLD.
Account fee tiers and trading permission, balances, margin mode, min notionals/max positions are not verified by public APIs and are not invented.
